selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods; constitutional/territorial status is identity context only and local ratings do not inherit New Zealand-wide sports evidence.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
New Zealand-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No tennis federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Constitutional or territorial status is context only, not sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
